commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+4' Pierre Sage is forced to make a change. Maxence Caqueret is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Paul Akouokou (Lyon).
90+4' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+3' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Anthony Lopes.
90+2' Matthieu Udol (Metz) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' Said Benrahma (Lyon) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Problems for Pierre Sage as Alexandre Lacazette is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mama Balde (Lyon) replaces him.
89' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
88' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jake O'Brien (Lyon) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' A pass into the penalty area from Ibou Sane (Metz) is intercepted by the defence.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lamine Camara will be replaced by Joseph Nduquidi (Metz).
81' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Lamine Camara (Metz) is given a yellow card.
78' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul after Lamine Camara (Metz) hacks down one of his opponents.
75' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Didier Lamkel Ze will be replaced by Arthur Atta (Metz).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joel Asoro leaves the pitch and Ibou Sane (Metz) comes on.
74' Lamine Camara (Metz) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
73' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
71' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' Here is a change. Ernest Nuamah is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Malick Fofana (Lyon).
70' Substitution. Orel Mangala walks off the pitch and Rayan Cherki (Lyon) comes on as a substitute.
69' Lamine Camara (Metz) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
68' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Metz.
66' A corner kick by Metz is thwarted by the well prepared Anthony Lopes (Lyon).
63' 34:66 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

60' 1 - 2 Maxence Caqueret is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the left post to make the score 1:2.
60' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
58' Metz keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
55' A substitution has been made. Cheikh Sabaly is replaced by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
51' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jake O'Brien (Lyon) and blew his whistle.
48' Said Benrahma (Lyon) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
46' Pierre Sage makes a switch. Said Benrahma (Lyon) is coming on in place of Gift Orban at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Clinton Mata inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Rough tackle by Clinton Mata (Lyon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Dangerous play by Matthieu Udol (Metz). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
37' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Cheikh Sabaly (Metz), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
35' Maxime Colin (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
34' Orel Mangala (Lyon) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
32' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
30' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
28' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
27' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
25' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
22' Gift Orban (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
15' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' 1 - 0 What a goal that is! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) goes on a mazy run and from inside the box he beats Anthony Lopes with a delightful chip. He makes it 1:0.
12' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

11' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Orel Mangala (Lyon) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
7' A quickly taken corner by Lyon.
6' Metz fail to score from a corner as Anthony Lopes (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.
5' The Lyon players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Marc Bollengier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
